Sam (Sales): quick handover for Equinox — short context: mid-market fintech, wants private VPC deployment for PII workloads, target pilot 2026-04-15, annual renewal 2027-02-01. they committed to a $18k/mo plan.
Priya (CS Manager): thanks — who on infra is owned for the VPC bits? any blockers for onboarding?
Sam (Sales): @Carlos will take lead on infra checklist, but they asked for IP allowlisting + SSO (Okta) + enterprise KMS. Sales notes: they already signed the security addendum. No legal blockers.
Priya (CS Manager): got it. priority list for CS: 1) SSO enablement 2) Provision private endpoint 3) Runbook + success criteria. can you paste contact and current open tickets?
Sam (Sales): contacts: @linda.e@equinox.com (IT), @tom.p@equinox.com (Product). Open tickets: DEV-4789 (VPC peering request, sales-created), SEC-1932 (security addendum processed). Also flagged a perf concern for long prompts in embeddings workload.
Carlos (Support Eng): noted. I pulled DEV-4789 — missing subnet CIDRs from the customer. @Sam can you ask them for the exact ranges? Also need their KMS key ARN for E2E test.
Sam (Sales): pinged contact, they replied with a partial CIDR list, asked for exact values by EOD PT. shared the KMS ARN placeholder: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01.
Priya (CS Manager): tagging owners: SSO: Priya (me) + Jesse for SAML testing; VPC/provisioning: Carlos; Success plan + metrics: Priya. Next steps: Carlos to open infra runbook PR, Jesse to run baseline perf eval on staging model, Priya to schedule kickoff with Equinox for 2026-03-30.
Jesse (SRE): I can run perf eval — assign me the sample prompt set and token budgets. will run tests by 2026-03-25.
OnboardBot: Reminder created — Kickoff Meeting scheduled: 2026-03-30 16:00 PT. Event ID: RB-2026-03-30-EQUINOX.
Priya (CS Manager): risk flags for renewal: 1) if we miss pilot by >4 weeks they may renegotiate pricing; 2) SSO delays reduce admin adoption; 3) perf regression on long-prompts. Mitigations: fast follow on CIDR + KMS, pre-signed test harness for SAML, baseline perf eval runbook.
Carlos (Support Eng): I'll draft infra checklist now and link to ticket DEV-4789. also will create a temporary test VPC on our side to validate throughput.
Sam (Sales): great — FYI they requested a single point of contact for first 30 days: Linda. Also asked for a weekly 30-min sync during pilot.
Priya (CS Manager): added weekly 30-min enablement slot to calendar invite. Owners: @Priya (CS) weekly lead, @Carlos infra escalations, @Jesse perf. Closing ask for Sales: please confirm exact CIDRs and confirm KMS key ARN by EOD.
Sam (Sales): will confirm. thanks team :raised_hands:
Priya (CS Manager): marking this thread as context for the kickoff. I'll create the success plan doc and share in #cs-playbooks after kickoff.
